scope: Task presentation and bounded reachable resets. Collision geometry, mass, inertia, passive joint parameters, control and physics timesteps are preserved.

view_contract.scope: Full object bounds inside frame. Every sampled ray that intersects the operation affordance must be unobstructed; require the center ray and at least three target samples. Rays through background outside a narrow feature are not counted as occluded. Native body poses drive both projection and triangle-ray tests.

steel.appearance_note: NVIDIA 4K milled steel normal plus original stainless albedo/ORM; gentle normal strength 0.18. Visual microstructure only, no geometric displacement.

light_wood.appearance_note: Pale fine-grain appearance proxy using NVIDIA Birch. The block remains balsa at 150 kg/m3 and 22.5 g; neither species identity nor mechanical properties are inferred from this visual texture.

ceramic.appearance_note: Engineering dielectric white glaze with subtle 4K coating normal, not a measured ceramic BRDF or a source-mug scan.

0.background_reason: Domestic storage in a furnished reading/work room
0.placement_reason: Place the drawer at [-0.23,-0.0813,0.574] m, yaw60, so its complete 160 mm stroke and full common reset box fit the shared front camera. Source geometry interval bounds and native seed-0 LOS/IK passed; no physical joint or collision parameter changed.

1.background_reason: Interior cabinet door in a furnished room
1.placement_reason: 60-degree oblique side placement at [-0.18, -0.075, 0.574] m: keep the full interaction in the shared front AgentView. Reset checks moving parts and fixed handle descendants over the full 160 mm rail stroke or 66-degree door task arc.

mechanism.appearance_note: Preserve original YCB tomato-soup-can diffuse label and authored UVs; add only a subtle 4K coating normal to its original OmniPBR shader. This is a coating-detail proxy, not a measured can normal.
